intro: A cheerful woman waves you down from beside a picnic blanket covered in bottles and blankets.
speaker: Breeder Bonnie
introDialogue: Oh! Are those your little ones?$They look… underfed, if you don't mind me saying.$My darlings drink only the finest milk. Care to see the difference it makes?
title: The Doting Breeder
description: Breeder Bonnie's baby Pokémon are absurdly well-nourished — each one clutches a bottle of its own. She'll happily part with a spare, but only for someone who can out-battle her pampered brood.

1.label: Accept Her Challenge
1.tooltip:
(-) Battle Pampered Baby Pokémon
(+) Baby Bottle
1.selected: "Wonderful! Don't hold back on account of their size, dear."

2.label: Politely Decline
2.selected: "Suit yourself! Do feed those little ones, won't you?"

outro: "My, my — you've earned this. Take good care of your little one!"
